pr.title: Add team invitations
pr.body: Admins can invite people by email to a workspace. Invite link expires after 7 days; invitee joins with the invited role.
pr.author: claude-agent

nodes.label: Invitation service
notes: Authorization check lives in the route layer, not in the service

nodes.label: Invitations schema
notes: Adds a table and a new schema entry; no backfill needed

reasons.message: Route registration changed: the `requireAdmin` guard is no longer applied to the invitation endpoints

nodes.label: InvitationService.createInvitation
notes: 1 dynamic call could not be resolved (this.hooks[event])

nodes.label: InvitationService.revokeInvitation
notes: Table name is computed at runtime; edge to db is unresolved

reasons.message: Member role is now passed through to the membership row (privilege assignment)
Delivery errors are caught and ignored; failed invitations are silent
Migration contains DROP COLUMN workspaces.legacy_invite_code (irreversible data loss)
1 of 6 call sites deviates from the pattern and passes an extra argument

hunks.patch:
@@ -0,0 +10,6 @@
+export class InvitationService {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly users: UserService,
+    private readonly workspaces: WorkspaceService,
+    private readonly hooks: Record<string, () => void> = {},
+  ) {}

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+CREATE TABLE invitations (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id),
+  email text NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  token text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  invited_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
+  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
+  revoked_at timestamptz
+);
+CREATE INDEX invitations_workspace_idx ON invitations (workspace_id);
+ALTER TABLE workspaces DROP COLUMN legacy_invite_code;

@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost/app
+APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
+INVITE_FROM=invites@example.com
 SESSION_SECRET=change-me
